name: @reticlehq/server
description: Reticle CLI, bridge and MCP server: a coding agent drives your running web app from the inside and gets a verdict with evidence, for change verification, access control, accessibility, performance and SEO checks.

scripts.prepack: node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs --clean dist && tsc -b --force && node ../scripts/alias-dist.mjs && node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/stamp-issuer-key.mjs && node ../scripts/pack-docs.mjs

author: Reticle contributors

reticle.changelog: 3.9.0 gets more installs to a first verdict. The one-line installer and reticle init now check your app and wait for your agent to connect. A lease reads a deployed preview with no SDK installed. Several false verdicts are fixed: a click that hit Reticle's own panel, a recorded flow that lost its assertion, and an iframe that took over a page's session. Every package is now Apache-2.0. Update the CLI and the SDK in your app.
breakingChanges: A headless page now opens at 1440x900, not 1280x720. Record your headless screenshot baselines again, or they report dimension-mismatch.
The JSON line of `reticle license` no longer has the `gated` and `coversNothingHere` fields.
